checkpoint.description: Post-Fight-Store purchase/equip checkpoint before taking the GO PRO transition fight.

private_artifact.policy: Hashes only. Savestate and extracted RAM remain outside Git.

career_control_state.note: No fight/progression occurred between checkpoints 14 and 15; the controlled change is Fight Store purchasing/equipping.

money_deltas_checkpoint_14_to_15.name: career_bank
money_deltas_checkpoint_14_to_15.evidence: The bank falls by exactly $4,000 after the three reported purchases. Fight Store runtime strings also render $11,795.

This money field does not decrease when $4,000 is spent, cleanly separating it from bank. Combined with its prior fight-income accumulation, this is strong evidence for an earnings/cumulative-inflow quantity; exact UI-source identity still requires a post-purchase Sign Contract readout or static writer trace.

The field rises by exactly the amount the confirmed bank falls across a purchase-only checkpoint. Exact scope (career spending, store spending, current-phase spending, or another purchase accumulator) remains unresolved.

equipment_interpretation.evidence: This compact persistent region changes when trunks, mouthguard, and foul protector are purchased/equipped. Because all three equipment changes occurred in the same checkpoint, individual slot semantics are intentionally not assigned yet.

base_training_stat_control.implication: Equipping the visible BODY +1 / CHIN +1 gear does not rewrite the already-mapped persistent base training-stat block. Gear bonuses therefore appear to be represented/applied separately from base trained ratings.

overhaul_implications: Retail already separates base boxer training ratings from equipment-derived stat modifiers, useful for preserving permanent progression and temporary/equipment bonuses independently in the overhaul.
Checkpoint 15 cleanly separates spendable bank from a second accumulated-money field and exposes a new purchase-sensitive money accumulator candidate.
The Fight Store has a compact persistent equipment-state region suitable for later one-item-at-a-time slot isolation if equipment customization becomes an implementation target.
next_capture_note: Checkpoint 15 is the correct pre-GO-PRO baseline. Any later transition analysis must compare against checkpoint 15 rather than checkpoint 14 because the player deliberately purchased/equipped gear first.
